summary: Iteration 18 comprehensive backend + frontend testing. Backend: 7/7 pytest tests PASS covering (1) POST /api/max/webhook — 200 {ok:true} in <5s, accepts JSON & empty body; (2) POST /api/leads with valid RU phone → telegram_sent:true (confirmed 'POST https://api.telegram.org/.../sendMessage HTTP/1.1 200 OK' in backend logs); (3) invalid phone → 400; (4) GET /api/content contains full thank_you block with all 11 required keys; (5) admin login → PUT /admin/content updates telegram_url → GET verifies persistence → rollback to original works; (6) team.members = 6. Frontend: /thank-you page renders with [data-testid=thank-you-page], heading 'Спасибо. Скоро свяжемся.', 3 messenger buttons (telegram/whatsapp/max), maps button, back-home button. Yandex Metrika script tag with id=111530949 present in HTML head and window.ym function is loaded. Back-home link navigates to /. E2E: filled ContactForm with valid phone → submit → redirected within ~1.4s to /thank-you?source=contact_form (verified URL). Team section renders 6 [data-testid=team-card-N] cards after scroll (Framer Motion useInView requires visibility). Zero console/page errors. Regression: main page loads, no runtime errors.

issues: Global ExitIntentPopup fires on /thank-you page too after ~12s. Consider disabling on /thank-you route the same way it's disabled on /admin/* (App.js GlobalExitIntent — add loc.pathname === '/thank-you' to the early-return). Not blocking, but shows an exit-intent 'don't leave' popup right after a user just successfully submitted their lead, which is UX noise.

action_items: OPTIONAL UX: Disable ExitIntentPopup on /thank-you route in App.js GlobalExitIntent — currently after successful lead submit user sees exit-intent 'wait we have a gift' popup, which is redundant.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/max/webhook (line 179-189) — correctly wrapped in try/except for body read, always returns 200. Good — MAX platform requires <30s ACK.
SuccessOverlay redirects to /thank-you?source=X after 1.4s AND fires trackLeadSubmit(source) — spec compliant, all 4 usages have source prop.

ExitIntentPopup is mounted at App level via GlobalExitIntent — currently only disabled on /admin/*. Consider also disabling on /thank-you to avoid showing 'don't leave' popup right after a successful submit.
metrika.js reachGoal wraps window.ym safely with try/catch and no-op if not ready — good defensive coding.
MAX credentials NOT set in preview backend/.env — send_lead_to_max returns False silently, which is expected per agent-to-agent note. Not a bug.
